grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: like with count and noncount nouns
grammarPoints.shortName: like with count and noncount nouns
grammarPoints.rule: Count nouns like 'apples' and 'bananas' take -s when you talk about liking them in general. Noncount nouns like 'fish' and 'chicken' stay the same. Ask 'Do you like...?' and answer 'Yes, I do. I like...' or 'No, I don't. I don't like...'
grammarPoints.pattern: Do you like + noun(s)? Yes, I do. I like + noun(s). / No, I don't. I don't like + noun(s).

intro_examples.text: Do you like fish? No, I don't. I don't like fish.

rules.title: Ask about food with Do you like...?
rules.jp_title: 食べ物について尋ねるときは 'Do you like...?'

rules.title: Add -s to count nouns you like
rules.jp_title: 好きな可算名詞には -s をつける
rules.subtitle: Add -s to count nouns like apple and banana when you talk about liking them in general.
rules.jp_subtitle: apple や banana のような数えられる名詞は、一般的に好きだと言うときに -s をつけます。

examples.jp: りんごは好きではありません。

rules.title: Noncount nouns like fish and chicken don't change
rules.jp_title: fish や chicken のような不可算名詞は形を変えない
rules.subtitle: Words like fish, chicken, soup, and rice stay the same — don't add -s.
rules.jp_subtitle: fish、chicken、soup、rice のような単語は形を変えません。-s をつけません。

rules.title: Answer with I do / I don't
rules.subtitle: Answer 'Yes, I do' or 'No, I don't', then repeat with 'I like' or 'I don't like'.
rules.jp_subtitle: 'Yes, I do' か 'No, I don't' と答え、そのあと 'I like' か 'I don't like' で繰り返します。

japanese.title: 可算名詞と不可算名詞を使った like
japanese.rule: apples や bananas のような数えられる名詞（可算名詞）は、一般的に好きだと言うときに -s をつけます。fish や chicken のような数えられない名詞（不可算名詞）はそのままの形で使います。'Do you like...?' と尋ね、'Yes, I do. I like...' または 'No, I don't. I don't like...' と答えます。
japanese.pattern: Do you like + 名詞(s)? Yes, I do. I like + 名詞(s). / No, I don't. I don't like + 名詞(s).

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Indefinite articles: a, an
grammarPoints.rule: Use 'an' before a word that starts with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u). Use 'a' before a word that starts with a consonant sound.
grammarPoints.pattern: a + consonant-sound noun. an + vowel-sound noun.

rules.title: Use an before a vowel sound
rules.subtitle: Use 'an' before a word that starts with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u).

examples.jp: 私は古いペンを持っています。

rules.subtitle: Use 'a' before a word that starts with a consonant sound.

rules.title: Ask Is there a/an...?
rules.subtitle: Use 'Is there a/an...?' to ask if one thing is there.
rules.jp_subtitle: 1つのものがあるかどうかを尋ねるときは 'Is there a/an...?' を使います。

rules.title: Ask questions with Does...have a/an...?
rules.subtitle: Use 'Does...have a/an...?' to ask if someone or something has one thing.
rules.jp_subtitle: 誰か（何か）が1つのものを持っているかどうかを尋ねるときは 'Does...have a/an...?' を使います。

japanese.title: 不定冠詞 a と an
